items.question: Which female figure accompanies the deity Saiṃhikeya in this identification?
premises: The verse predicates accompaniment using the form vṛtā.
The instrumental form śaciṣṭhayā specifies the accompanying figure.
This statement continues the identification of Saiṃhikeya given in the previous verse.
items.inference: The deity Saiṃhikeya is identified as accompanied by Śaciṣṭhā.
uncertainties: The precise identity or epithetic sense of śaciṣṭhā is not fully determined from this verse alone.
